funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants

amount.raw: Small, up to £2,000; Large, from £2,001 to £6,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals at any stage in their career; applicant must be the author or editor of the proposed publication and have a publisher confirmed with a publication date scheduled within three years.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals seeking to disseminate research on British art through the publication of monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles. Supports practical publishing costs such as image licensing, subventions, external contributor fees and translation costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed. Organisations can only apply for one Research Project Grant per round.
opportunities.summary: Flexible support for organisations undertaking ambitious and sustained research in the field of British art. Primarily supports staff costs towards facilitating a research project with public-facing outcomes and/or legacy (e.g. exhibition, digital project, catalogue).

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Exhibition Publication Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or non-profit; the exhibition on which the publication is based may be forthcoming or already taken place.
opportunities.summary: Supports the dissemination of research on British art by helping organisations produce publications related to their exhibitions and displays, including practical publishing costs such as image and production costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Event Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed.
opportunities.summary: Supports organisations to disseminate research on British art through live, online and hybrid events intended for a variety of audiences. Can support costs such as venue hire, accommodation for speakers and staffing.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking a conservation research project or technical analysis leading to a research project. Items must be in public or charitable ownership and accessible to the public.
opportunities.summary: Helps protect and preserve significant works of British art by funding organisations to undertake original and needed conservation research, including staff and equipment costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Digitisation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking work to digitise items and material in their own collections (photographic, archival, bound volumes, objects, paintings, publications, etc.).
opportunities.summary: Provides financial support to organisations seeking to make their collections freely available to audiences online via digitisation, including personnel and equipment costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: ERBA Research Travel Bursaries
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to Members of Emerging Researchers in British Art (ERBA); non-members may apply with membership pending. Bursary is to be used between November 2026 and April 2027.
opportunities.summary: Micro-grants for ERBA members to help cover transport, accommodation and reasonable expenses for a specific research trip (e.g. to a library, archive, collection, site, or to meet a key contact or attend a relevant event).

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to international applicants. Up to £8,000 available to individuals at any career stage; £8,001-£20,000 available to individuals at postdoctoral level or with equivalent research experience or above.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for individuals undertaking research in British art, including research time (e.g. staff replacement, daily rates) and/or research travel to view collections or visit archives, plus supporting costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals enrolled to start (with a place confirmed), or already undertaking, a master's level or doctoral level degree in the field of British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals beginning or continuing a master's or doctoral degree who may face barriers in undertaking their course of study.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to registered students at undergraduate level and above, from any country. Project must focus on British works of art on paper from the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries (prints, drawings, watercolours).
opportunities.summary: Funded by the Andrew Wyld Fund, provides flexible financial support for registered students to undertake research trips to examine historical works on paper firsthand.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship

amount.raw: total of £32,000 for one year, or split over two years if part-time

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals who have applied for or are in receipt of an offer of a master's degree place at a UK-based institution, due to begin the course between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Provides full funding to support a master's degree (MA, MPhil, MSc or equivalent) in the field of British art, designed to bring new perspectives to our understanding of British art as part of the New Narratives scheme.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship

amount.raw: total of £96,000, £32,000 a year for three years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals who have applied for or are in receipt of an offer of a doctorate degree at a UK-based university, starting between April 2027 and April 2028. International applicants not qualifying for home fees may apply but must source extra funding elsewhere.
opportunities.summary: Provides full funding (fees plus living expenses) to support a doctorate in the field of British art, part of the New Narratives scheme to increase diversity of perspectives and challenge received histories of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship

amount.raw: one year at £35,000 total, or two years at £70,000 total (£35,000 per year)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals at postdoctoral level (or with equivalent experience) or above.
opportunities.summary: Provides financial support for individuals to undertake a major in-depth research project in the field of British art as part of the New Narratives scheme to reshape our understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship

amount.raw: full board and accommodation at the British School at Rome for three months, plus an honorarium

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals with at least a first degree, from pre-doctoral PhD candidates to those internationally recognised in their field.
opportunities.summary: Provides a three-month stay at the British School at Rome for individuals undertaking advanced research relating to cultural contact, exchange and influence between Britain and Italy.
